overview_description.description: Tapi is a fintech company that provides e-wallet solutions and merchant services for both online and in-store transactions. It offers a comprehensive range of financial technology services designed to facilitate seamless transactions and enhance financial management. Their payment solutions include digital payment processing for businesses, allowing integration with various payment methods. They also provide e-wallet services, enabling consumers to manage their transactions easily through mobile wallets that feature balance management and transaction history. For merchants, Tapi offers tools to accept payments both online and in-store, along with analytics and reporting features to track sales effectively. Additionally, they facilitate cross-border transactions, providing services for international payments and currency exchange. To ensure security, Tapi implements fraud prevention tools and robust measures for data protection

about_short_description.short_description: Tapi is a fintech company that provides e-wallet solutions and merchant services for both online and in-store transactions.

product.name: Regional Payments API and Infrastructure
product.description: An API-driven payments infrastructure that enables fintechs, banks, neobanks, and other companies to offer bill payment, cash transactions, mobile top-ups, and digital vouchers through one regional integration.

product.name: Pago de servicios (Bill Payment)
product.description: An API for enabling users to pay utility and other recurring bills, including energy, gas, water, telecommunications, internet, insurance, healthcare, and education services.

product.name: Cash In/Out
product.description: A service that enables cash deposits and withdrawals through a network of more than 15,000 active physical locations and participating retail businesses.

product.name: Recargas TAE (Electronic Airtime Top-Ups)
product.description: An API for mobile airtime top-ups and prepaid recharges from participating telecommunications providers, with support for automated and recurring recharge workflows.

product.name: Gift Cards
product.description: A digital voucher service that lets platforms sell PINs, gift cards, subscriptions, and memberships from participating consumer and digital-service providers.
